description: This Java source file defines the MediaCodecUtil class, providing utility functions for querying and selecting media codecs, especially for video and audio decoding, including handling secure and HDR capabilities, and maintaining deny/allow lists for specific codecs and device models.

classes.name: MediaCodecUtil
classes.description: Utility class for media codec capabilities, including deny/allow lists, codec querying, and device-specific codec handling.

classes.name: MediaCodecUtil.CodecCapabilityInfo
classes.description: Wrapper class encapsulating codec info, capabilities, and related properties, with methods to determine secure, tunnel, HDR, and software decoding support.

methods.name: getAllCodecCapabilityInfos
methods.description: Returns an array of all available decoder capabilities.

methods.name: isCodecDenyListed
methods.description: Checks if a codec name is on the deny list.

methods.name: getSecureDecoderSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix used for secure decoders.

methods.name: isHdrCapableVideoDecoder
methods.description: Determines if a codec supports HDR based on mime type and capabilities.

methods.name: isSoftwareDecoder
methods.description: Checks if a given codec info corresponds to a software decoder.

methods.name: findVideoDecoder
methods.description: Finds a suitable video decoder based on parameters like mime type, security, HDR, software support, tunneling, resolution, bitrate, and fps.

methods.name: findAudioDecoder
methods.description: Finds a suitable audio decoder based on mime type and bitrate.
